name: HSRP failover (syslog) + tracked-uplink metric anomaly (SNMP): FHRP failover confirmed
comment: C5: fhrp_state_change is emitted by the new HSRP/VRRP syslog branch. The tracked uplink's counter anomaly (device_telemetry) is the independent second modality that confirms a real election with impact. No link-down, so the link-fault discriminator does not fire.
